research.facts:
Colorado Flu Season / Kids Flu Shots
- **Last season Colorado child deaths:** 8 [HIGH — CPR News, CBS News Colorado coverage cited by multiple search results]
- **Last season child hospitalizations:** 1,169 [HIGH — UCHealth, news coverage]
- **Highest total since 2004:** Yes [HIGH — Garfield County Health/UCHealth language]
- **Early start this season:** Yes — UCHealth reports 6x more positive flu tests vs same period last year [HIGH — UCHealth site]
- **Vaccine target:** Subclade K (dominant variant from last year's season) [HIGH — CDPHE, Denver7]
- **AAP recommendation:** All children 6 months and older, annually [HIGH — longstanding AAP recommendation, confirmed in Nov 2026 policy statement search]
- **Quote (paraphrase):** Dr. David Higgins, CU pediatrician: "Unvaccinated children are at substantially higher risk of severe disease, hospitalization, and death" [HIGH — CPR/CU Anschutz source]
- **Federal vaccine guidance confusion:** RFK Jr./HHS dropped some childhood vaccine recommendations (Jan 2026 reports) [MEDIUM — multiple news sources but complex ongoing story; don't reference directly in article without more context]
- **Where to get shots in COS:** Most pharmacies and pediatric clinics — standard, no specific new list available [MEDIUM — general guidance only]

x_posts.label: Post 3
